ops.whyShort: First Crossroads inn step. Bind here for the turn-ins, not in Orgrimmar.
ops.text: Set your hearth at this inn, the town you turn quests in, rather than in a capital.

sources.label: Mythic Store 2026-09-21: inns still grant rested XP

ops.text: Set your hearth at this inn, the town you turn quests in, rather than in a capital.

sources.label: Mythic Store 2026-09-21: inns still grant rested XP

ops.whyShort: One existing dungeon step. Quest clear once; five entries an hour; inside kill XP is not the grind.
ops.text: Do this dungeon once for its quests: kill XP inside is not a grind, and you can enter a dungeon at most five times an hour.

sources.label: Mythic Store 2026-09-21: one quested clear, repeat kill XP very little
Warcraft Tavern 2026-11-20: 5 dungeon entries per hour

ops.whyShort: Optional. Rested object is the Leatherworking Camp Tent at skill 20, not the Cooking fire. Leatherworking stays optional.
ops.text: Optional: outdoor rested XP comes from a Leatherworking Camp Tent (skill 20), which adds 5% of a level if you are below that, not from the campfire itself.

sources.label: Blizzard camping: Basic Campfire is Cooking 1; Camp Tent is the rested object
Wowhead Camp Tent row: skill 20, 5% of a level

ops.whyShort: Level-1 step. Talented can start talents at 5, but launch spend is 16 and a first character has few points.
ops.text: Alt note: Legacy's Talented ranks can move your first talent point as early as level 5, but launch spend is capped at 16 and a first character has few points.

sources.label: Icy Veins Legacy: Talented to level 5; launch spend cap 16

ops.whyShort: Kill-count step. Finish Plainstrider Menace before changing layer.
ops.text: Finish this kill count before you change layer; do not switch layer in the middle of an objective.

sources.label: Warcraft Tavern 2026-11-20: addon layer targeting reduced; untargeted switch not removed
